# Blandet start på september giver muligheder til investorerne

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-09-04  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish Millionærklubben episode (Euroinvestor) with Lars Svendsen (Svendsen & Tudborg) and Lars Persson (Aktierådet), recorded ahead of the US jobs report and at the start of the show's stock game. The market is flat to mixed. Topics include Sectra's strong margins, Sweden's new nuclear reactor deal (both panelists own Studsvik), and listener questions: the panel is cautious on DSV, Per Aarslev and Couche-Tard, and says to hold Nexans and Solar. Lars Svendsen is bullish on cheap legacy carmakers (Volkswagen, BMW, Volvo Car) and on Petrobras, and expects money leaving the US to flow into Europe.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 PBR — Petrobras | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lars S's stock-game pick on a higher oil price this autumn; price about 20.5, target 25.

#### Reasoning

Guest Lars Svendsen expects the oil price to near record levels this autumn. He sees Petrobras as an Equinor-sized oil producer with good fields and a price of about 20.5, and targets 25. It is framed as a stock-game pick but described as a strong belief.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil price fails to rise this autumn

> *"Den koster vist 20,5 eller sådan noget. Og så jeg gætter på, at den skal have 25."*

---

### 🟡 NEX — Nexans | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Both panelists say to keep it; trim a third or trim an overweight position; electrification is a long-term trend.

#### Reasoning

Lars Persson: the uptrend is paused but electrification is a structural driver, so keep it and trim only if it is overweight. Lars Svendsen: the good run is not over; if unsure, sell a third. The main risk is copper price volatility driven by China.

#### Sell Triggers

- copper price punctures
- trend breaks down
- position becomes too large a share of the portfolio

> *"hvis du er i tvivl, så sælg en tredjedel og behold to tredjedel og lur"*

---

### ⛔ DSV — DSV | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Falling trend; support at 1,250, and 1,100 if that breaks. Lars P won't own it; Lars S waits for about 1,000 and a turn in the economic cycle.

#### Reasoning

Lars Persson (technical): the trend is down and he stays away; if 1,250 breaks, the next level is 1,100 and there is risk of a Novo-style slide. Lars Svendsen: goodwill-heavy acquisitive growth and a hard Schenker integration. He would buy near 1,000 or on a cyclical upturn such as Ukraine peace and European reconstruction.

#### Sell Triggers

- price reaches ~1000 support
- business cycle turns up / Ukraine peace

> *"Men jeg skal ikke have nogen DSV i hvert fald. Og det nærmeste støttiniveau, det er 1250."*

---

### 🟡 SOLAR-B — Solar A/S | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Don't sell at 238; a break above it could run toward 260-300. Electrification and takeover potential; director's wife bought at 500.

#### Reasoning

Lars P: margins are weak (EBIT 2.1% vs 3.0%), but a break above old resistance at 238 could run toward 260-300, so don't sell at break-even. Lars S (holder): electrification demand, industrial exposure and sector M&A (Kesko/Brødrene Dahl) make it a possible takeover target, and insider buying at 500 supports holding.

#### Sell Triggers

- margins keep falling
- construction downturn persists

> *"Så jeg vil ikke sælge på kost 230."*

---

### 🟠 PAAL-B — Per Aarslev | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Falling trend and no buy signal yet; long-term quality with a raised margin outlook. Wait for a dip and a turn.

#### Reasoning

Lars P: the stock is consolidating after a strong rise, EBIT margin guidance is raised to 5-5.3%, and infrastructure and climate-protection work are tailwinds, but there is no buy signal yet. Lars S: a long-term stock to buy when it is down, which it is not yet.

#### Sell Triggers

- contract delays (e.g. Femern) hurt results

> *"Så nej, der er ikke rigtig købsignal endnu. Så jeg vil vente lidt."*

---

### 🟠 PEAB-B — Peab | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars S has started studying it; Lars P notes an upward trend, +15% this year.

#### Reasoning

Guest Lars Svendsen sees Peab busy on Danish roads and streets and is studying it. Lars Persson notes the upward technical trend and a 15% gain this year, a tailwind.

#### Sell Triggers

- trend breaks

> *"det ser lidt sjovere ud, fordi trenden er opadgående"*

---

### 🟡 SVIK — Studsvik | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Both panelists disclose they own it; it is part of the new Swedish 1.2 GW reactor deal.

#### Reasoning

Sweden is returning to nuclear, with Studsvik among the signatories of the reactor agreement for the 2030s. Both panelists hold shares, which implies a positive stance.

#### Sell Triggers

- nuclear project cancelled

> *"Jeg har altså Sludsvig."*

---

### 🟠 SECT-B — Sectra | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Strong report: revenue +25% and margin up to 19.8%; the backlog drop is seen as timing of lumpy project sales.

#### Reasoning

Lars Persson highlights rising margins as the ideal profile. He sees the falling order backlog as normal for project sales that could refill with a single large order.

#### Sell Triggers

- order backlog fails to refill

> *"indtjeningsmaginerne gik fra 15,5 til 19,8"*

---

### ⛔ ATD — Alimentation Couche-Tard | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

The EV-charging thesis is peripheral, the stock is highly priced and slow (+13% in 3 years).

#### Reasoning

Lars S: EV charging is not a main argument, and the stock is systematically highly priced. Lars P: there is lots of competition and it is not a fast runner.

> *"Det skal være hovedargumentet, du skal gå ind for."*

---

### 🟢 CA — Carrefour | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Held in Lars S's firm; he plans to buy it himself soon. Cheap at ~16 vs past 55-65; possible takeover target.

#### Reasoning

Lars Svendsen notes Couche-Tard offered 18 when the stock was around 16, and the French government blocked it. He expects someone else to bid eventually and sees the stock as depressed with a decent dividend.

> *"jeg har den ikke selv, men det skal jeg nok snart"*

---

### ⛔ TSLA — Tesla | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars S would never own it. Trim if it is overweight, and recheck the original thesis.

#### Reasoning

Lars Svendsen: he would never have bought it and would not own it now. Lars Persson: clip the position if it is too large, otherwise revisit why you bought it (self-driving, new models).

> *"Jeg ville aldrig have købt dem, så vil jeg heller ikke ej dem nu."*

---

### 🟢 VOW3 — Volkswagen | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lars S owns it and is itching to buy more; restructuring (50,000 jobs, fewer models) is welcome.

#### Reasoning

Lars Svendsen: old carmakers are extremely beaten down but have parts businesses, banks and truck units of real value. VW's restructuring could make it worth a lot.

#### Sell Triggers

- restructuring fails

> *"det klæder voldsomt i mine fingre for at købe flere"*

---

### 🟡 BMW — BMW | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars S owns it and sees legacy carmakers as deeply undervalued.

#### Reasoning

Lars Svendsen holds shares and says legacy automakers are heavily beaten down relative to their asset value.

> *"jeg har jo allerede købt Stok 2'en i på både Folkevogn og på BMW"*

---

### 🟢 VOLCAR-B — Volvo Car | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lars S says Volvo Car is the next stock he will buy, at about SEK 18.

#### Reasoning

Lars Svendsen names Volvo Car as his next purchase and cites past success with the stock. It is part of his thesis that legacy carmakers are cheap.

> *"det næste, jeg tror, jeg skal købe, det er faktisk et helt andet sted. Det er Volvo Car"*

---

### 🟠 NKT — NKT | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars P: forming a bottom in a long-term uptrend driven by electrification; he regrets not re-buying.

#### Reasoning

Lars Persson sees NKT forming a bottom formation within an upward trend driven by electrification. He sold it earlier and suggests revisiting it.

#### Sell Triggers

- trend breaks down

> *"jeg sad og kiggede på NKT, som er ligesom ved at lave sådan en bundformation"*

---
